## 3. R7-B1 - physical-entry-only FD6 FIONREAD

A successful child calls ioctl(FIONREAD) exactly once, on FD6, in the physical-entry carrier scan and before the first byte of any FD6 frame or error. That result must be integer zero and equal the launch row. A preloaded byte, wrong descriptor, duplicate call, late call, error, nonzero result, or first output before the sample fails.

At post-carrier-exec-entry, locked-pre-cpython, and post-pyinitialize, a present FD6 row has queued_bytes_or_null exactly null and performs no FIONREAD. Those stages still freshly validate fstat, descriptor/status flags, ESPIPE and pipe capacity. Discovery twins therefore contain no scheduler-dependent post-write queue value; only the existing launch-hash normalization remains. No ACK pipe or timeout is added.

## 4. R7-B2 - locked durable publication and recovery

After canonical request parsing and before durable mutation, the controller opens the P00-fixed durability root, verifies the exact device/inode/owner/mode/mount and holds an exclusive nonblocking flock on parent-only FD34. Busy, unsupported or failed acquisition exits with zero durable mutation and zero child. Every compliant writer uses the same root-inode lock. The child fixed raw stub closes inherited FD34 and proves EBADF, then closes inherited FD50 and proves EBADF, before read49 can block. A parent death before SEIZE therefore yields EOF after releasing the child lock reference and inherited writer; a death after SEIZE invokes EXITKILL. The parent alone holds FD34 through terminal publication.

Under the lock, directories are scanned in the exact requests, attempts, prelaunch, launch, streams, joins, traces, results, attestations order. Only the closed dot-final.tmp.pid.starttime grammar is a stale temp. A candidate must be a same-device regular uid0/gid0 mode0600 nlink1 object. Such crash residue is unlinked, its directory fsynced and absence proved. An unknown name, symlink, hardlink, special file, wrong metadata, malformed final, prefix hole or cleanup failure poisons the root. A poisoned root is unusable until a separately authorized P00 redeploy; unknown objects are never guessed or deleted.

Before creating a temp, an allowed content-addressed final is completely reopened and revalidated. Exact existing bytes may be reused. A renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE) EEXIST branch always revalidates the winner, removes only this process exact temp, fsyncs and proves absence, then revalidates again. Attempt markers and attestations are never generic reusable EEXIST objects.

The discover prefix is R,A,P0,P1,L,S,J,K,U,Z; full-runtime is R,A,P0,L,S,J,K,T,U,Z. States are ABSENT, REQUEST_DURABLE_UNCLAIMED, CLAIMED_INCOMPLETE, COMMITTED_NONREPLAYABLE and INVALID_PREFIX. Only the exact R-only crash state may continue to A. Once A exists, the invocation is burned and never resumed. A complete Z is strictly nonreplayable: it launches no child and does not re-emit success. Power loss promises only a completed directory-fsync edge and may recover to either adjacent valid prefix, never a skipped/mixed state.

The 15-key Round-8 durability attestation embeds the exact publication-recovery object plus its digest and the kernel-transition index digest. Recovery has a closed lock row and gap-free operation rows for stale removal, state classification, existing-final reuse and rename-EEXIST cleanup. It contains no attestation, result envelope or self digest.

## 7. R7-B5 - parent-side kernel executable-transition monitor

The same future supervisor ELF uses parent-side pure PTRACE_SYSCALL. The child fixed raw stub executes close34, prove34 with F_GETFD/EBADF, close50, prove50 with F_GETFD/EBADF, then read(FD49,one byte); these are the only pre-attach syscalls. The reviewed attach policy enumerates every SETUP, ENTRY/in-flight and EXIT boundary for each prefix operation and the sole blocked-read state. The initial operation includes exact operation,phase,RIP,args,result/errno and a state-discriminated FD snapshot. The parent drives and records the exact remaining suffix and proves child34/50 absent before creating monitor FDs or releasing the barrier. A pre-SEIZE parent death removes the sole writer only after the child released and proved FD34/50; post-SEIZE EXITKILL applies. The parent leaves exactly 32,33,34,48,50 with raw 0 through 31 empty; signalfd4 promotes raw0 to51 and epoll_create1 promotes raw0 to52. Only after registration does it write byte01 on its parent-only50. The observed read entry or already-entered read, plus at most one reviewed read restart, yields one exact completion before strict ordinary pairing.

Every tracee, including failure cleanup, resumes only under PTRACE_SYSCALL. The exact x86_64 table and required-name/value universe includes NT_PRSTATUS, all PTRACE_GET_SYSCALL_INFO operation values, PIPE_BUF, F_GETPIPE_SZ, O_ACCMODE/O_WRONLY and every other consumed ptrace,signal,mask,epoll,fcntl,errno,PROT/MAP/SHM constant. Parent mask equals child mask plus SIGCHLD and signalfd consumes only SIGCHLD. Only reviewed pthread clone forms are allowed. Returning and terminal syscall entries are separate closed pending discriminants and are never re-interrupted. Epoch priority drains all returning entries by task ordinal, then individual exit entries by task ordinal, then the sole task0 exit_group only when no other entry remains. Prior interrupt/clone stops and validated syscall exits carry explicitly; an individual exit removes only its task, while exit_group accounts for the carried live set. No pending operation is canceled, and the remaining live set resumes only after the queue and every state/provider/policy check complete. A CLONE event registers and freezes its child before the initiator reaches the true syscall exit.

The bootstrap exec is a separate closed PTRACE_EVENT_EXEC object with complete inline execve args and a unique EXEC event ordinal. Top argv,env,path and provider fields equal the nested six-key args; the fixed ASCII path hash equals attach exec_path, and the event-message integer is the exact conversion of the EXEC row hex. It produces address state zero, then consumes the mandatory post-event syscall-exit stop before a fresh ENTRY phase. Task zero PID/starttime equal the attach child identity, and every ptrace event repeats the selected task row TID. Returning syscalls use strict returning epochs. Nonreturning exit/exit_group use terminal-entry epochs and a closed terminal union: each task row points to exactly one exit event; PTRACE_EVENT_EXIT message equals raw final wait status; exit status is status_u32 low eight bits; exit-group followers byte-equal the leader wait; signal termination and controller SIGKILL have disjoint exact causes.

Success is executable-VMA monotonic. Each stopped snapshot uses FD rows only for real PROC_ROOT,MAPS_READ and PROVIDER_REOPEN open/promote/close lifecycles, with separate raw0 and final40/41 EBADF proofs. The baseline group selects the EXEC state; every completed returning transition has separately triggered entry/before-state and exit/after-state groups, every selected terminal leader has one terminal-entry group, and every signal terminal has one signal-delivery group. Followers and controller kill have none. The complete capture tuple is unique, so a zero-effect transition cannot reuse or reassign evidence. map_files/fd readlinkat calls beneath FD40 create no FD and no fabricated row; their targets feed the immediately cross-checked address/provider identity. A new executable interval must be the exact reviewed regular, nondeleted, non-memfd provider segment and stopped memory must byte-equal it. W+X,anonymous/SHM executable memory,unknown/deleted providers,replacement,moving/removing X,MAP_FIXED overlap,unmap and executable-byte mutation fail. VDSO is read and hashed; the exact 4,096-byte --xp vsyscall interval is the sole unreadable exception and its provider digest is SHA-256 of the complete twelve-key kernel-runtime-evidence.v6 object. The complete address projection reproduces every 0x12 and applicable 0x13 byte-for-byte.

FD6 frame type 0x14 is a control/evidence frame, not a seventeenth normalized token. PREMAIN_SEAL closes the loader group. Every initialization/import recipe emits ENTER and EXIT even with zero transitions, but emits one existing 0x13 if and only if its precommitted dynamic-load ordinal is nonnull; a null group emits no synthetic delta frame. DISPATCH_SEAL forbids later executable mapping gain. The parent records address-aware states and transitions, while BASE receives only reviewed address-free policy/group recipes. Discovery run 0 retains only a closed provisional per-process row whose digest hashes its complete process object; it then unregisters,drains,closes and EBADF-proves FD48/51/52, clears pending SIGCHLD and leaves only32/33/34 before fresh run1 construction. After run1 the controller constructs the sole two-process request-level transition index and both final rows/attestations. Full runtime has one process row. The index is published at prefix K and cannot backfill BASE.

On a monitor failure the parent freezes the exact failure-epoch live-task set, retains required descriptors, injects SIGKILL only through PTRACE_SYSCALL and `waitpid(__WALL)`-reaps that live set to ECHILD; tasks already terminal retain their prior status. It never uses PTRACE_CONT,detaches or publishes PASS K. Tracee violations exit 122, parent-monitor infrastructure failures exit 123, and unrecoverable kill/reap relies on PTRACE_O_EXITKILL with no output and exit 124. BASE remains 19 roles, FINAL remains 24, and tokens/origins remain 16/13.

      "Run canonical preprocess_identity once. teacher_input is exact C-order <f4[T,215]; continuous is columns 0:149 converted once to C-order <f8[T,149]; use the same canonical geometry, clocks, masks, run bounds, and binary64 edge lengths.",
      "For every run in run order, before any teacher call, run the geometry-only two-stage integer_landmarks rule.       "Within the same run, consecutive retained landmarks alone form ordered traversal edge bounds [L_j,L_(j+1)); no cross-run or nonconsecutive bound.",
      "For each run independently compute F5 from continuous[149], edge_lengths, and these bounds.       "Cast each complete run static vector once to C-order <f4[298]. In run order issue one CPU float32 TempoRACTeacher forward for that run's exact <f4[Trun,215] input; no batch or padding. Use the exact environment, eval, inference_mode, one thread, no autocast/TF32.",

      "stage_input_contract": {
        "canonical_rule": "Duplicate keys, BOM, invalid UTF-8, CR, non-recursively-sorted keys, noncanonical integers, booleans as integers, nonfinite numbers, negative zero, missing/extra LF or trailing bytes fail. input_index_sha256 is raw SHA-256 of complete canonical UTF-8 JSON including the one LF and is absent from the object. Invocation carries complete lowercase bytes hex, never a path, object handle or digest-only substitute.",
        "row_closed_keys": [
          "bytes",
          "content_schema",
          "media_type",
          "ordinal",
          "role",
          "sha256"
        ],
        "row_rule": "bytes is an integer 1..2^64-1 and sha256 is 64 lowercase hex over complete raw object bytes. Rows expand each recipe slot in slot order with ordinal 0..multiplicity-1, total exactly row_count, unique role/ordinal and no sorting/dedup. Every row byte-count,digest,schema,media,owner,seed,step/order and transitive FK must pass the literal slot validator; equal digests never collapse roles. Before a CAS lookup, digest_source is resolved through the exact literal recipe token and must equal row.sha256; bytes_source independently resolves the authoritative byte count or CAS_SIZE_OF that digest and must equal row.bytes. Thus caller row values never authorize themselves.",
        "schema": "temporac.stage-input-index.v5",
        "top_level_closed_keys": [
          "authority_context_sha256",
          "authority_record_or_null",
          "authority_record_sha256_or_null",
          "contract_sha256",
          "handler_token",
          "input_recipe_sha256",
          "owner",
          "rows",
          "schema"
        ],
        "top_rule": "authority_context_sha256 must be read from and equal the current BASE dispatch table's independently rehashed embedded context; a caller value never authorizes itself. For the first 54 owners authority_record_or_null and its paired hash are both null. G5A-COMMIT and G5B-JOIN carry the same complete temporac.stage-input-derived-g5a-authority.v5 record and its standalone canonical-bytes SHA-256; each child independently rebuilds the record from the BASE context, current validated FINAL/environment and the exact 54 durable traces before equality is accepted. K7-FINAL is not externally invocable and receives no index. contract_sha256 is the formally accepted Round8 successor; owner,handler_token,input_recipe_sha256 equal the exact descriptor and unchanged recipe wrapper. Missing,extra,cross-owner,caller-selected,stale-contract or record/context substitution fails."
      },

        "hash_rule": "For a child-emitted failure, launch_instance_sha256_or_null is null for every failure through and including LAUNCH_HASH; it becomes that child's exact digest only after LAUNCH_HASH succeeds. The stream mode byte independently follows child_stream.failure_prefix, including exact mode with null digest only for a LAUNCH_HASH failure after canonical launch parsing. For a controller-synthesized failure attributable to one child, the digest is null before that child's complete controller-side launch plus carrier construction and is that exact digest for PRELAUNCH,FORK,EXEC,KERNEL_TRANSITION_MONITOR,STREAM_PARSE or WAITPID even when the child never validated FD7. PRELAUNCH is selected only after both launch and carrier construction have completed and while validating/persisting their closed prelaunch record. A full-runtime aggregate DURABILITY/OUTPUT failure repeats its sole launch digest. A discover-twin aggregate DURABILITY/OUTPUT failure after both joined uses null because two launch digests exist and selecting either is forbidden; request/attempt/operational/carrier-construction failures with no completed current carrier also use null. An earlier discovery run never supplies the hash for a later run's prelaunch failure. No other null/present choice exists.",
        "schema": "temporac.native-failure.v5",
        "stage_assignment_rule": "Each process executes its applicable stage-order array. stage is the first named boundary that fails; a more specific boundary wins over enclosing/later cleanup. Child uses child_stage_order. AUDIT_BUFFER_ALLOC/CAPTURE/FLUSH/RELEASE are disjoint: callback catalog/argument/canonicalization/append failures are CAPTURE and byte drain/write is FLUSH. INITIAL_MAPPING_CAPTURE covers sole initial 0x12. After Py_Initialize returns, expected-initialization raw/normalized sequence,provider,origin and nonmapping equality failures are POST_INITIALIZE_READBACK; only before/after/delta/group/mapping/provider-link/frame failures are INITIALIZATION_MAPPING_CAPTURE. IMPORT_GROUP_MAPPING_CAPTURE covers corresponding mapping boundary for each explicit PyImport; PRE_DISPATCH_IMPORT covers its module/provider/optional-absence/expected-row nonmapping failures. TERMINAL_MAPPING_CAPTURE covers replay,fresh terminal set,sole terminal 0x12. Generated candidate/twin/trusted matching maps only TRUSTED_GENERATED_CONSUMPTION. DISPATCH covers Python call/exception/type and RESULT only returned-byte cap/schema/hash/wrapper. Controller uses controller_stage_order. child_fd_actions/output preservation,reservations,sealed inputs,null-OFD,pipe/FD48,target install map OPERATIONAL_MEMFD_CONSTRUCTION; pre-fork set/record maps PRELAUNCH. Child exit125 maps FORK and controller exit123; child exit126 maps EXEC and controller exit122. Malformed,truncated,short,early-EOF or broken FD6 child bytes map STREAM_PARSE and exit122.           "canonical_locator": "/var/lib/temporac/replay-v4/stage-input-cas-v4/objects/<sha256[0:2]>/<sha256[2:64]>",
          "flags": "openat2 RESOLVE_BENEATH|RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS|RESOLVE_NO_MAGICLINKS then O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW",
          "rule": "From slash, reopen every absolute-path component with no symlink or magiclink and require the final root identity to equal every literal field in root_identity. For each lookup retain one root dirfd identity, require the two-character shard and 62-character object basename derived only from an independently authorized lowercase digest, then fstat before and after the exact positive-length read plus one-byte EOF proof. device,inode,mount,type,mode,uid,gid,nlink,size,mtime_ns,ctime_ns must be unchanged and the raw SHA-256 must equal that authorized digest. cas-size first resolves that independent digest and returns the count from this same complete read; row.bytes and st_size alone are never authority."
        },
        "object_contract": {
          "basename_regex": "[0-9a-f]{62}",
          "gid_u32": 0,
          "kind": "regular",
          "link_count": 1,
          "permissions_u16": 292,
          "uid_u32": 0
        },
        "publication_contract": {
          "authorized_writers": [
            "P00 deployment publisher",
            "native controller derived-G5A publisher"
          ],
          "lock_rule": "For a derived-G5A publish epoch the native controller has only external0/1/2 and no request/child descriptor. Open slash O_DIRECTORY|O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW and require raw3; openat2 from that dirfd to the exact context-bound CAS root with RESOLVE_BENEATH|RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS|RESOLVE_NO_MAGICLINKS and require raw4; fstat/mount-identity validate root4, close/prove3, then flock(4,LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB), retrying EINTR only. EWOULDBLOCK/unsupported/mismatch fails with zero CAS/request mutation. Hold4 through startup scan,all content publishes and final rescans; unlock/close/prove4 before acquiring controller request-root FD34 or creating any child/launch FD. P00 uses the same root-inode nonblocking-lock semantics in its own deployment epoch. Thus this CAS lock is never inherited and does not add a fixed child FD.",
          "rule": "Only an authorized controller/P00 publisher holding the separately validated stage-CAS root-inode nonblocking exclusive lock may write. Create the exact same-shard sibling temp O_CREAT|O_EXCL mode0600, write complete bytes with EINTR-safe positive progress, fdatasync then fsync and close, chmod0444, renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE, fsync shard, reopen and fully validate. EEXIST succeeds only after identical bytes and final metadata validation; overwrite/truncate is forbidden. Recovery removes only an exact locked-writer temp grammar with regular root0:0 mode0600 nlink1 same-device identity, fsyncs and rescans; unknown entries poison the root and require P00 redeploy. Committed objects are append-only and never deleted. Handlers are read-only. The exact lock_rule is mandatory for every mutation.",
          "temp_grammar": ".<62-lowercase-hex>.tmp.<positive-pid>.<positive-starttime-ticks>"
        },

        "source_token_rule": "The closed token grammar remains inventory:self:/receipt_sha256; inventory:upstream:/upstream_receipt_sha256/%o; self-receipt:<RFC6901-pointer>; parent:<earlier-role>:<RFC6901-pointer>; parent-root:<earlier-root-role>:class=<literal-class>:<RFC6901-pointer>; cas-size:<complete-digest-source-token>; active-capability:{grant|ledger}:{sha256|bytes}; derived:{g5a-receipt|g5a-root-index}:{sha256|bytes}; g5b-projection:<exact-role>/%o:{sha256|bytes}; memory:g5b-receipt:{sha256|bytes}. inventory tokens resolve only the unique pre-g5a-receipt-inventory carrier in the current BASE dispatch-table context, open its exact CAS bytes, validate the exact 54 rows/owner order/106 direct edges and select self or the current upstream ordinal; row values cannot supply an expected digest or byte count. self-receipt and parent tokens resolve only already fully validated earlier rows. parent-root resolves one exact class child and, for the G5B pilot scope, the sole natural-prediction-completion row's one child index with exactly three ordered NATP rows and one common top-level pilot digest. cas-size uses the already resolved authority digest and same complete CAS read. derived tokens resolve only the complete authority record carried by G5A/G5B and independently rebuilt under stage_input_authority_context_spec; no caller value is a locator or expectation. g5b-projection and memory tokens are only the private same-instance K7 continuation. Resume only the chosen initiator. A PTRACE_EVENT_CLONE is intermediate: register/freeze the child,then reach the true syscall EXIT. After returning validation,or after an individual exit is terminally reaped,process the next pending entry without resuming the carried world. exit_group is legal only when no other entry is pending,then terminates the carried live set.
